# gReader News

> An independent open-source RSS reader project, not an official continuation of the original gReader.

## Product and project

- [Product overview](https://greaderapp.com/): visible capabilities and limitations.
- [Project story](https://greaderapp.com/story): background and independent-project status.
- [Product FAQ](https://greaderapp.com/faq): accounts, OPML, offline reading and privacy limits.
- [Reading guides](https://greaderapp.com/blog): sourced explanations of reading workflows.
- [App source](https://github.com/laravelcompany/app.greaderapp.com): implementation and release notes. Source versions do not certify store rollout or all devices.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://greaderapp.com/privacy-policy): local data, Android requests, browser proxy and website advertising.
- [Terms](https://greaderapp.com/terms)
- [Cookies](https://greaderapp.com/cookies)
